reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates resonant acoustic mixing and L-PBF of Y2O3-coated NiCoCr powder, achieving dispersion strengthening and improved properties, which supports the coating and consolidation premises. However, the evidence is for a different alloy (NiCoCr) and does not address AlCrFeNiSi, miniature components, or residual stress reduction, leaving the alloy-specific and geometry-specific premises unsupported.
premises: Resonant acoustic mixing can uniformly coat metal powder with nanoscale Y2O3
L-PBF can consolidate Y2O3-coated powder into dense parts with dispersed oxides
Dispersed Y2O3 nanoparticles act as heterogeneous nucleation sites and refine grain structure
Grain refinement and dispersion strengthening reduce residual stresses and improve mechanical properties
These benefits apply to AlCrFeNiSi powder and miniature L-PBF components
